mods.name: Plushie Party
mods.description: Right-click a Re-Furn plushie with a stick or music disc to party. Faithful Java port of the Plushie Party Bedrock addon by RedEagleStudios.

releases.notes:
**Independent rebuild of `main` with a fully pinned toolchain — the output is byte-identical (SHA-256) to the committed [`releases/plushie_party-26.2.jar`](releases/plushie_party-26.2.jar), confirming the build is reproducible.**

**Verified in this release cycle:**
- **Reproducible build**: Temurin JDK 25.0.5+8 · Gradle 9.8.2 · Fabric Loom **1.19.3** (pinned stable, was `1.19-SNAPSHOT`) — rebuilt jar matches the committed artifact exactly.
- **Runtime boot test**: the jar + Fabric API `0.161.0+26.2` boots a real **Minecraft 26.2** Fabric dedicated server (`Loader 0.19.5`) to `Done` — `plushie_party 26.2` loads among 43 mods, all recipes parse (1587 total), **zero errors**.
- **Build hardening**: Maven Central mirror filter moved into `build.gradle` (direct Central returns HTTP 429 on some networks; the Google mirror serves identical artifacts) and a **Gradle wrapper (9.8.2)** added, so the documented `./gradlew build` now works out of the box.

**Gameplay unchanged from v1.0.3** — Creeper Plushie block+entity with 1:1 Bedrock placement/rotation, squish-on-click animation, stick/music-disc party toggle, server-authoritative dance with 74-tick sync, original toy sounds, and the **Gangnam Style disc** (original synthesized track) with its survival recipe.

**Requirements:** Minecraft Java **26.2** · Fabric Loader **0.19.5+** · Fabric API **0.161.0+26.2** · Java **25** (bundled by the vanilla launcher).

**Install:** drop `plushie_party-26.2.jar` into `mods/` together with Fabric API.

releases.notes:
**Updated build — supersedes v1.0.1. Two changes vs the original:**

- **Fix:** accepts Fabric Loader **0.19.5 or newer** (previously required 0.20.1) — fixes the startup error `Replace mod 'Fabric Loader' (fabricloader) 0.19.5 with version 0.20.1 or later`
- **New:** survival recipe for the **Gangnam Style** disc — 8× lime wool around 1× note block

**Requirements:** Minecraft Java 26.2 | Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ | Fabric API 0.161.0+26.2 | Java 25

**Install:** 1) remove the old plushie_party jar from mods/  2) drop this jar + Fabric API into mods/

All classes, sounds and animations are unchanged from the original build.

mods.name: Plushie Party
mods.description: Right-click a Re-Furn plushie with a stick or music disc to party. Faithful Java port of the Plushie Party Bedrock addon by RedEagleStudios.

releases.notes:
Faithful Fabric port of the **Plushie Party** Bedrock addon (by RedEagleStudios) for Minecraft Java **26.2** ("Chaos Cubed", Fabric Loader 0.20.1, Java 25) — plus the requested built-in **Gangnam Style music disc**.

## Install
1. Fabric Loader for 26.2 + [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 26.2
2. Drop `plushie_party-26.2.jar` into `mods/`

## What's inside
- Creeper Plushie (exact 14-cube model + face decals), invisible synced hitbox block, 1:1 placement/rotation/orphan-protection
- 0.5 s click-squeak with the original 3 sounds (vol 0.8, pitch 1.0, range 7)
- Party system 1:1: stick or music disc toggles, 16-block radius, players AND mobs dance, 74-tick sync, multi-party merge, exact Molang dance curves
- **Party music**: disc → that song loops at the plushie until the party stops; stick → bundled 14.8 s party loop
- **"Gangnam Style" disc** (`re_plushie_party:gangnam_style`): real jukebox item (comparator 1) with an **original synthesized** 87 s party track (the PSY recording is copyrighted and not included — swap guide in the README)
- Crafting: 7× lime wool + gunpowder

Verified on a dedicated 26.2 server (boot, registration, datapacks, clean shutdown).

readmeSummary: A faithful Minecraft: Java Edition Fabric mod port of the Minecraft Bedrock addon Plushie Party by RedEagleStudios.
